messages:
alex: Quick pulse — vendor sent a partial-rack ETA for satellite eu-west2. We might hit our small-demo alloc threshold tonight; anyone owning quota/procurement who can confirm?
mina: saw the vendor note. They say 2 racks by ~03:00 UTC but the GCP reservation hasn't been created yet.
rory: @mina can you check reservation quota? we need ~48 GPUs reserved to avoid job failures. I can reshuffle demo jobs if needed.
mina: running a quick check: `gcloud compute reservations list --filter="region:eu-west2"` -> returns nothing right now.
mina: filing vendor ticket VN-8743 and pinging the account rep. adding ops tag.
irene: heads-up — Finance put a temporary hold on the vendor CC because of an invoice mismatch. procurement is stalled until that's cleared.
sara: can we borrow from the us-west demo pool as a short-term workaround? I can move 8 nodes for the night.
alex: borrowing is ok if we update routing and latency-aware policies; otherwise low-latency canaries will hit higher p99.
rory: I can prepare the fallback canary change. I'll open a PR for a fallback route and a feature-flag guard.
rory: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/+/9876 — reviewers @alex @mina (WIP, do not merge until we know).
mina: vendor-bot update: VN-8743 -> vendor replied 'processing; provisioning started; ETA ~02:45 UTC; will confirm serials'.
vendor-bot: Note: invoice VN-INV-901 flagged for mismatch. Contact procurement@vendor.com to clear.
irene: I'm escalating the payment hold now and looping in procurement. If cleared within ~2h we can avoid cross-region borrow.
alex: proposed plan: (1) mina confirm reservation or escalate to vendor ops (2) irene escalate CC/invoice to procurement (3) rory create fallback PR but hold merge behind a feature-flag. Anyone object?
sara: +1 — I'll draft a short migration runbook for the 8-node borrow so oncall has steps.
mina: quick update: reservation still missing; vendor ops acknowledged and provisioning is showing as 'in progress' in their portal. Ticket note: ```VN-8743: vendor confirmed 2 racks, provisioning kicked off, ETA 02:45 UTC. awaiting serials and GCP reservation request completion.```
rory: will avoid merging anything risky. I'll switch to a feature-flag toggle instead of immediate route swap.
alex: perfect — I'll check back at 01:45 UTC and ping if anything changes. :eyes:
